item.title: Rescue efforts under way after tanker strikes river cruise boat in US
item.description: American Heritage paddleboat with 129 passengers on board is partially submerged on Mississippi River in New Orleans.

item.title: LIVE: FAA issues nationwide ground stop after communications outage in US
item.description: US air regulators have issued a nationwide ground stop for departing flights, citing a communications problem.

item.title: FAA grounds US flights nationwide after ‘communication issue’
item.description: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy says federal aviation agency is ‘investigating the issue’.

item.title: Pope Leo cheered on return to Peru city where he served as bishop
item.description: An estimated 1.5 million people have welcomed Pope Leo XIV back to the city in Peru where he once served as bishop.

item.title: Qatar and Turkiye send message of deterrence with new defence pact
item.description: Qatar and Turkiye have signed a mutual defence pact, deepening their partnership amid growing regional instability.

item.title: Australia captain Cummins denies involvement in ‘Sandpapergate’
item.description: Australia cricket captain Cummins has rejected claims by ex-teammate Usman Khawaja linking him to 2018 ball-tampering

item.title: Pope thanks crowds on emotional return to ‘second home’ in Peru’s Chiclayo
item.description: The Chicago-born pope was welcomed by huge crowds in the coastal city, on the final leg of his South America tour.

item.title: Paraguay’s ex-president Pena faces new charge over Ueno bank collapse
item.description: The criminal association charge over his alleged role in the collapse of the bank comes a week after his removal.

item.title: Microsoft says services still returning amid widespread outage
item.description: Governments, businesses, individuals were disrupted globally as server failures stretch into second day.

item.title: Nigeria ends 21-day Ebola contact monitoring with no secondary transmission
item.description: None of the 62 contacts identified after the first case developed the disease, although 13 contacts reported fever.

item.title: Migrants risk deadly route to Spain’s Canary Islands
item.description: More than 7,400 migrants arrived in Spain’s Canary Islands during the first 10 days of November.

item.title: IRGC says tanker caught fire after hitting mines in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: A liquefied gas carrier caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz after hitting naval mines, according to the IRGC.

item.title: How will the US deal with Nvidia scandal?
item.description: Tech giant CEO resigned and will testify before Congress.

item.title: At least 10 killed in Guinea clashes over gold mining ban
item.description: Guinea banned artisanal gold mining in Siguiri on November 2 due to environmental degradation, causing mass exodus.

item.title: Israel bars supplies needed to treat six-year-old Gaza burn victim
item.description: Six-year-old burns victim Masa is one of the patients in Gaza whose recovery is under threat due to Israeli restrictions

item.title: Iran honours fallen soldiers in Iran-Iraq war with missile display
item.description: Thousands gathered in Tehran for a mass funeral honouring 110 unidentified soldiers killed in the Iran-Iraq war.

item.title: Eisenkot slams Netanyahu’s ‘racist’ campaign against Palestinian Israelis
item.description: Prime ministerial hopeful calls attempts to marginalise and smear Palestinian citizens of Israel 'an anti-state act'.

item.title: No emails, no problem? Workers joke about Microsoft outage
item.description: Workers worldwide have been finding humour in a global Microsoft outage that disrupted Outlook, Teams and Copilot.

item.title: The fight over Canadian steelworker jobs
item.description: Stelco's US owner blames Trump's tariffs for layoffs, but its support for those same tariffs has raised questions.

item.title: Car bombings in Russia kill military officer, injure ex-Ukraine PM adviser
item.description: Moscow blames Kyiv for a series of car bombings that have targeted people linked to the war with Ukraine.

item.title: Jerusalem Daily: Baby dies from cold in Gaza
item.description: A baby dies from the cold in Gaza as 53 countries urge Israel to allow aid in.

item.title: Sixth victim confirmed in DC condo-related shooting in US, police say
item.description: Police confirm sixth victim in DC condo shooting; suspect dead after barricading himself and starting a fire.

item.title: US Treasury warns against rate hikes during US-Iran war energy ‘shock’
item.description: Despite Treasury's Scott Bessent's remarks, financial tracker CME Fed Watch forecasts rate hike in December likely.

item.title: Truck and bus crash in India’s Assam state kills at least 24 people
item.description: Several children and the bus driver were among those killed, officials said, with the death toll expected to rise.

item.title: Turkiye and Qatar sign mutual defence agreement
item.description: The pact was signed after ​the President met Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim ‌‌bin Hamad ​Al Thani in Istanbul on ⁠⁠Friday.
